**Alpha test build** of the Mahuva Kshatriya Rajput Samaj community directory (version 1.1). For invited testers only.

- **mvpmi.apk** — install on Android phones (Android 10 or newer). It connects to https://samaj.kavigsv.com.
- **BUILD-INFO.txt** — version, server and whether this is a signed or a test build. With a test build, uninstall the previous app before installing a newer alpha.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt** — checksum to verify the download.

What is new: login with mobile number + 4-digit PIN (Main Admin: mobile + password), Village Admins created by the Main Admin, village verification before final approval, app lock, redesigned directory. Everyone registers again (fresh start). See `docs/ALPHA_TESTING.md` for what to test and how to report problems.
